episodes.title: Mighty Pups
episodes.overview: In this high-flying, heroic mission, the PAW Patrol are given Mighty Pup powers after a mysterious meteor lands in Adventure Bay. When Mayor Humdinger and his nephew trap Ryder and steal the meteor to take over the city, the pups must work together and use their new powers–from Chase's super speed to Marshall's mighty heat, Rubble's super strength and more–to race to the rescue and save the day.

episodes.title: Marshall's Rusty Makeover
episodes.overview: Rusty from Rusty Rivets gives Marshall's firetruck a makeover.

episodes.title: Ready, Race, Rescue
episodes.overview: It’s the Adventure Bay 500! The pups are ready to be the pit crew for their race hero, The Whoosh! When the legendary racer is unable to drive in the championship race, he calls on Marshall to take the wheel and race in his place!

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. the Super Sonic Sound System
episodes.overview: Chase and Rocky take on a maniacal musical menace: DJ Harold Humdinger's Super Sonic Sound System.

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Copy Cat Marshall
episodes.overview: It's up to "Charged Up" Mighty Marshall to clear his name when Copy Cat steals Marshall's vehicle and impersonates him, melting everything in his path with his heat paw power.

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. the Teenybots
episodes.overview: "Charged Up" Rubble goes wrecking-balling for Teenybots when Copy Cat and Harold team up and lead a small army of minirobot minions in an invasion of Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Super Meow Meow
episodes.overview: "Charged Up" Skye and Zuma square off against a cyclonic catastrophe-causing robo-kitty when Harold reactivates "Meow Meow," super-powering it up with a meteor shard.

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Teleporting Copy Cat
episodes.overview: When the Copy Cat copies Harold's robot's teleporting powers, it's up to "Charged Up" Rocky and his X-ray vision to find him and Chase's sonic bark to save the day.

episodes.title: Charged Up: Pups Save a Super-Powered Puplantis
episodes.overview: When Harold's failed attempt to steal the meteor lands it in Puplantis, it's up to "Charged Up" Zuma and Skye to get it back where it belongs before the superpowered pearls give away the secret of the Mer-pups.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Tromping Triceratops
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway takes a selfie with Chickaletta, startling a triceratops into tromping right toward the raptor nesting grounds; a Dino Rescue is launched to save the eggs and stop the stomper.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Baby Stegosaurus
episodes.overview: When Humdinger swipes the Dino Patroller and endangers a school of baby stegosauri, it's up to Ryder, Rex and the Pups to come to the Dino Rescue.

episodes.title: Jet in soccorso
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol, along with the royal pup Sweetie, must help the Princess of Barkingburg defend the land on her birthday from the Duke of Flappington, the Princess of Barkingburg's cousin, who had acquired the power of a mighty levitation gem to combined to his own. This leads to Skye to face off her fear of eagles and lead the PAW Patrol into their biggest aerial rescue.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Pterodactyl Egg
episodes.overview: A pterodactyl mother and her egg become trapped on a ledge after a rock slide.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Dino Christmas
episodes.overview: Christmas in Dino World is interrupted when a volcano causes a landslide that traps a Brachiosaurus, and it's up to Ryder and the Pups to come to the Dino Rescue.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save the Baby Raptors
episodes.overview: A baby raptor gets inside the Dino Lookout, which causes commotion; Rex and Zuma race to save the raptor's siblings, and Ryder and the Pups search for its parents.

episodes.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Tyrannosaurus' Birthday
episodes.overview: A surprise birthday party for a Tyrannosaurus turns into a dino rescue when the startled guest of honour stomps off, getting stuck in a pit full of quicksand.

episodes.title: Cat Pack - Rubble and Wild and Yarn Ball
episodes.overview: Rubble and Wild rescue animals from a giant runaway ball of yarn.

episodes.title: Cat Pack - Skye and Rory Flip It
episodes.overview: Skye and Rory rescue Cora the painter hanging from a scaffold.

episodes.title: Cat Pack - Marshall, Leo and a Ferris Wheel
episodes.overview: Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

episodes.title: Cat Pack - Everest, Shade and the Mountain Goat
episodes.overview: Everest and Shade rescue a baby mountain goat stuck in a crevasse.

episodes.title: Pups Stop a Big Leak
episodes.overview: The pups help Cap'n Turbot and cousin Francois plug a water tower leak.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Baby Anteater
episodes.overview: A baby anteater's fingers get stuck to a galloping robotic pony.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Hatch Day
episodes.overview: The Pups rescue Ace and her special delivery for Chickaletta's party

episodes.title: Pups Save the Munchie Mobile
episodes.overview: The pups rescue Mr. Porter and his stranded Food Truck.

episodes.title: Valiente: A Tracker Story
episodes.overview: Tracker and Carlos come across a series of nocturnal animals fleeing the scariest part of the region - the Shadow Jungle - Tracker must brave his fear of the dark and stop a new villain, Lucita Mala, who believes the entire jungle belongs to her!

episodes.title: A PAW Patrol Christmas
episodes.overview: Santa gets ill, Christmas is cancelled in Adventure Bay, Mayor Humdinger goes to the North Pole to take all the gifts for himself. Rubble and the rest of the PAW Patrol will have to make a sacrifice to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Christmas!

episodes.title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe
episodes.overview: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.

episodes.title: Everest and the Big Chill
I cuccioli e la gattina
episodes.overview: Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli salvano una gattina che si era persa nella baia, ma chi salverà loro dai mille dispetti della gattina?

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il treno bloccato
episodes.overview: Ryder, Rubble e Rocky chiedono aiuto a Chase perché il treno di Katie e Cali è rimasto incastrato in una frana!

episodes.title: Pup Pup Boogie
episodes.overview: Alla stazione di Adventure Bay, la Squadra dei Cuccioli deve lavorare in fretta per riparare i binari e rimuovere un vagone prima che arrivi il treno successivo.

episodes.title: Cuccioli nella nebbia
episodes.overview: Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli lottano contro il tempo per riparare il faro.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano le tartarughe marine
episodes.overview: Ryder, Chase e Rubble escogitano un piano per aiutare le tartarughine marine appena nate ad attraversare la strada e raggiungere la spiaggia senza correre rischi!

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il supercucciolo
episodes.overview: Sulla spiaggia di Adventure Bay si è arenato un piccolo di balena! Riuscirà la Squadra dei Cuccioli ad aiutare il piccolo e a farlo tornare dalla madre?

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il circo
episodes.overview: Ryder riceve una chiamata dal presentatore del circo: l'elefantina Ellie è scappata dal treno del circo!

episodes.title: Gallinella superstar
episodes.overview: La gallinella da borsa della sindaca Goodway, chiamata "Chickaletta", è scomparsa. Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli la cercano in ogni angolo di Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: La piccola oca
episodes.overview: Marshall si fa un nuovo amico del cuore quando un papero che ha battezzato "Fuzzy" lo prende in simpatia.

episodes.title: La gara in mongolfiera
episodes.overview: Quando la sindaca Goodway prende accidentalmente il volo in mongolfiera, Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli devono correre in suo soccorso per salvarle la vita e vincere la gara!

episodes.title: Cuccioli meccanici
episodes.overview: Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli devono correre in soccorso di Alex che ha preso il largo con la sua "tricicletta".

episodes.title: Il cucciolo pompiere
episodes.overview: Marshall dimostra di essere un vero eroe quando si ferma per spegnere un vero incendio sulla spiaggia, durante una gara contro il tempo per vincere un trofeo.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i coniglietti
episodes.overview: Yumi si accorge che nella sua fattoria continuano a scomparire le carote, allora decide di chiedere aiuto a Ryder e alla Squadra dei Cuccioli.

episodes.title: Un cucciolo spettacolare
episodes.overview: Katie è entusiasta all'idea di portare un membro della Squadra dei Cuccioli a una gara di toelettatura che si terrà nella città vicina.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la baia
episodes.overview: Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli ripuliscono una piccola macchia di petrolio sversato in acqua per salvare gli animali di Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il sindaco
episodes.overview: Quando la famosa statua di Adventure Bay finisce sul fondale della baia, Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli devono escogitare un piano intelligente per riportarla a galla!

episodes.title: I cuccioli incontrano Rubble
episodes.overview: Vediamo un flashback di quando Rubble è entrato a far parte della Squadra dei cuccioli!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano Wally
episodes.overview: Quando Wally il tricheco resta impigliato in una vecchia rete da pesca, Ryder e la Squadra dei cuccioli lo aiutano a risalire in superficie e lo mettono in salvo.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i dolcetti
episodes.overview: Il furgone del Sig. Porter, pieno zeppo di cibo per cuccioli, slitta sul ghiaccio vicino alla riva: Ryder e la Squadra dei Cuccioli devono assolutamente intervenire!

episodes.title: I cuccioli prendono la seggiovia
episodes.overview: Mentre Katie e la sua gattina Callyi sono sulla seggiovia, questa si ferma di colpo lasciandole sospese sopra la pista da sci, senza via di fuga!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la festa western
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol are having a great time at the Adventure Bay Hoedown, but trouble starts to brew when Farmer Al's cows get spooked out and are on the loose in Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e Alex salvano Cali
episodes.overview: While Cali is playing with her favorite toy on Farmer Yumi's farm, she gets stuck on the top of the silo, which is not safe.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e la nave fantasma
episodes.overview: A Halloween party turns into a spooky time when there's a ghostly figure roaming around on a ship. Can the PAW Patrol solve the paranormal mystery and save the Halloween party?

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il primo giorno di scuola
episodes.overview: It's Alex's first day of school, but he has lost his backpack! So the PAW Patrol agrees to help him find it.

episodes.title: I cuccioli accendono le luci
episodes.overview: It's Chase's birthday and the other pups and Katie are setting up Chase's surprise birthday party at Katie's Clinic.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la piscina
episodes.overview: It's a hot day and the pups head for the water park, but the pool is empty! The water tower that pumps water into the pool is tilted and has a bent pipe.

episodes.title: Cuccioli da circo
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol, for the first time, must all work together to help Eunice and Ellie save the circus when most of the performers are late.

episodes.title: I cuccioli fanno un tuffo
episodes.overview: La nave di capitan Turbot rischia di affondare dopo essersi incagliata. Ma intervengono i Paw Patrol!

episodes.title: La nevicata
episodes.overview: È in arrivo una tempesta di neve e i Paw Patrol devono salvare il raccolto di tutte le fattorie.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il Natale
episodes.overview: Santa's sleigh crashes and breaks in a snow storm on Christmas Eve, and all the presents are strewn across Adventure Bay. It's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the sled, collect the reindeer, find the gifts, find the magic star, and most importantly, save Christmas for Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Cuccioli sulla neve
episodes.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il mostro delle nevi
episodes.overview: The pups find strange footprints in the snow on the mountain outside Adventure Bay. Everyone thinks it's a "snow monster" and it's scaring the skiers away.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un super cucciolo
episodes.overview: Rubble is pretending to be a super pup and tries to handle a rescue all by himself, but soon, Ryder and the Paw Patrol have to save Rubble.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il robot di Ryder
episodes.overview: When Ryder's Robot Pup breaks and starts going wild around Adventure Bay, it takes the whole Paw Patrol to help Ryder find it.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e la scimmietta
episodes.overview: An escaped baby monkey named Mandy leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay, when she steals Mr. Porter van full of bananas.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il gufo
episodes.overview: Chase befriends a baby owl and with the PAW Patrol helps rescue its mother who is trapped in the knothole of a fallen tree.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un pipistrello
episodes.overview: A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell and Mayor Goodway can't ring it. Ryder and the Pups attempt to rescue the bat quietly so it doesn't wake up, but it does and causes trouble around town. It's up to Ryder and the Pups to get the Bat and return her to her Bat cave.

episodes.title: Il dentino di Alex
episodes.overview: Alex is afraid to go to the dentist, so Chase and the PAW Patrol work together to show Alex that fears can be overcome.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la caccia alle uova di Pasqua
episodes.overview: It’s Adventure Bay’s annual Easter Egg Hunt and the pups are helping Mayor Goodway with the egg decorating. The hunt for a very special egg leads Ryder and the PAW Patrol on an exciting adventure.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il ballo al faro
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot has accidentally locked himself inside the lighthouse, so it is up to the pups to rescue a rowboat drifting out to sea.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano Ryder
episodes.overview: When Ryder and a goat named Garbi are trapped on a ledge at Big View Trail, it is up to the pups to save them.

episodes.title: La grande corsa dei cuccioli
episodes.overview: It's Adventure Bay Race Day and the pups are about to race each other all across the town to see who is the fastest pup. One other competitor unexpectedly shows up though, Alex in his super trike!

episodes.title: I cuccioli e la torta
episodes.overview: Mr.Porter enters a cake competition and needs Ryder and the pups to help him bake the biggest and tastiest cake. The race is on to get their cake baked and to the competition on time!

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il fagiolo magico
episodes.overview: Rubble has a wondrous dream, similar to Jack and the Beanstalk, where Marshall grows a giant beanstalk and Alex is a giant. However, when giant Alex starts to cause havoc, Ryder and the PAW Patrol must keep him occupied.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i Turbot
episodes.overview: When Cap'n Turbot needs to get a picture of the rare Blue Footed Booby Bird when his French cousin, Francois Turbot, decides to help but gets caught on a cliff! It's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue him and bring the two cousins together again.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il campeggio
episodes.overview: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

episodes.title: I cuccioli e le tartarughe in fuga
episodes.overview: Tons of baby turtles are popping up all over the town. Can the PAW Patrol help get them back to their homes before they get hurt?

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano l'alieno
episodes.overview: An alien lands on Earth at Farmer Yumi's place, and the gang try to repair his spaceship so he can return home.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un rospo volante
episodes.overview: Marshall gets a pet frog, and it jumps into a helicopter prior to a big frog-jumping competition.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il tesoro dei pirati
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot accidentally stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout. When the PAW Patrol rescues him, they find an incomplete treasure map. The adventure is on as the pups follow clues to find the missing map pieces, and eventually to an amazing sunken pirate treasure!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i pinguini
episodes.overview: The pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un piccolo di delfino
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano Jake
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la parata
episodes.overview: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la campana subacquea
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i castori
episodes.overview: When a storm washes away Chompy the Beaver's dam, he starts chomping wood all over town.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un fantasma
episodes.overview: A mysterious Ghost is causing havoc around the Lookout at night. The Pups and Chase in his new SPY GEAR set up a stakeout to bust it.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano lo spettacolo
episodes.overview: The Pups are going to put on a Medieval play in town square, but Cap'n Turbot's castle stage prop ends up collapsing and trapping him!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano l'acrobata del cielo
episodes.overview: Skye's favorite stunt pilot, Ace Sorensen, is heading to Adventure Bay to put on a fantastic air show. Just before arrival she runs into engine trouble!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un matrimonio
episodes.overview: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi are getting married! Farmer Yumi's barn is being decorated for the big day and all the pups are helping, but a big storm blows in and takes down a wall of the barn!

episodes.title: Il nuovo cucciolo
episodes.overview: An Arctic storm picks up, but Jake finds help from a brave mountain ranger pup named Everest!

episodes.title: I cuccioli e la scimmia dispettosa
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol heads to the Jungle in the PAW Patroller to meet Ryder's 10 year old pen-pal, Carlos.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un gregge
episodes.overview: Chase is taking part in a herding competition and starts to herd people around town as practice which causes more trouble than good.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il grande freddo
episodes.overview: A wintertime storm causes trouble all over Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una partita di basket
episodes.overview: Marshall is nervous about playing in the PAW Patrol basketball team. Chase lets Marshall sit out, but when Zuma and Rocky get injured, Marshall is forced to take over.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il talent show
episodes.overview: It's Adventure Bay Talent Show Day! Mayor Goodway is excited but afraid there won't be enough acts! Ryder's super talented pups can definitely help out.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la serata delle pannocchie
episodes.overview: Ryder and the Pups help Farmer Al prepare his annual Corn Roast, complete with a Corn Field Maze! Bettina accidentally tips over some hot BBQ coals onto the piles of corn that begin to pop, pop, POP into piles of POPCORN!

episodes.title: I cuccioli lasciano Marshall a casa da solo
episodes.overview: Ryder and the Pups head out for a day of Parachute training, but Marshall decides to stay back because of his fear of heights.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i cervi
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot goes out ice fishing and finds a family of Deer stuck on the slippery ice! They must have tried to get across the frozen Bay for food! Ryder and the PAW Patrol to the rescue!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un amico
episodes.overview: Feeling like his clumsy ways are constantly messing up his friends' fun, Marshall decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off into the woods. Once the pups notice Marshall is gone, they jump to action to find him and bring him back to the Lookout.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un clandestino
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol is on another road trip--this time to the icy tundra to help Jake count penguins.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un pappagallo
episodes.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol head to the Jungle in the PAW PATROLLER to help their good friend CARLOS find his lost Parrot, Matea!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano l'ape regina
episodes.overview: When Cap'n Turbot notices the light in his lighthouse isn't working properly, he discovers it's bee-cause a BIG beehive is inside it!

episodes.title: I cuccioli diventano baby sitter
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway has her hands full with her twin niece and nephew Julia and Julius. She calls on the PAW Patrol to rescue them from a tree, and then twin sit for the day!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i fuochi d'artificio
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway receives a package of piglets instead of the fireworks she was expecting. It turns out that the mailman has been making sloppy deliveries as he keeps delivering each package to the wrong address.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una famiglia di elefanti
episodes.overview: The Pups are on a PAW Patroller road trip to the Savana where they meet up with Photo Safari fans Cap'n Turbot and his cousin François Turbot. In the middle of the night the campers are awakened by an intruder who turns out to be a lost baby elephant - Gilda.

episodes.title: I cuccioli e i gatti dispettosi
episodes.overview: Adventure Bay has been picked as a Finalist in the Tidiest Town Contest and looks like they're going to win! That is until Mayor Humdinger unleashes his Kitten Catastrophe Crew and those naughty kittens mess up everything in sight.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una cansirena
episodes.overview: When the Pups and Cap'n Turbot camp out under the very rare Magical Mer Moon, magical things begin to happen. Lured by the mystical Mer pup song and then transformed into Mer pups themselves, Skye and Zuma and even water resistant Rocky perform an underwater rescue in a sunken old ship. Cap'n Turbot and Ryder help out by diving deep to bottom of the Bay in their Diving Bell to help a Mer Mom and pup.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i maialini
episodes.overview: PAW Patrol, Farmer Al & Alex running Corny and Emma Chase, Zuma,  Skye and Rocky is sick they go to home

episodes.title: I cuccioli e il fantasma del capanno
episodes.overview: It's spooky good times as Jake is cleaning up an old miner's cabin in the woods to revamp it as a ski chalet! Rubble and Rocky are happy to lend a helping hand, that is until their lunch disappears.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un'avventura
episodes.overview: Alex is working towards getting his Action Scouts Fire Safety Badge, and who better to help him learn all about Fire Safety than Marshall and the PAW Patrol!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una sorpresa
episodes.overview: It's just another regular day in Adventure Bay as the PAW Patrol is called to duty. First they have to help Mr. Porter who has his rump stuck in a stump which turns out to be the home of a neighborhood skunk!

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la gara dei sindaci
episodes.overview: It's the annual Mayor's Race and Mayor Goodway is determined to give it her best.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il bottino
episodes.overview: Ryder helps Mayor Goodway sort through the old cabin of Outlaw Wild Wilbur when they come across a map for his buried treasure.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano Walinda
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Wally's special friend, Walinda, gets tangled in an anchor chain.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un osso enorme
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin are in the middle of an archaeological dig when the cliff they are on collapses all around them.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un agitato Francois
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano i pinguini
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una pizza
episodes.overview: While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano Skye
episodes.overview: Ryder and the Pups to save Skye, Skye's way to home

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano il concerto
episodes.overview: When a storm blows through the town right before a concert, the pups must work together to clean up the mess.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un'aquila
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway's backpack slips down the side of a cliff with Chickaletta in it.

episodes.title: I cuccioli abbaiano con i dinosauri
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol is on a big excavation dig in the jungle with Cap'n Turbot looking for dinosaur fossils when they unearth 3 fossilized eggs. Before they know what's happening the eggs start to hatch and there are three baby pterodactyls running around Adventure Bay!

episodes.title: Kan-fu!
episodes.overview: While Sensei Yumi teaches all the Pups the ancient art of Pup-Fu, Mayor Humdinger steals an ancient scroll that holds all the secrets of the art.

episodes.title: I cuccioli trovano un genio
episodes.overview: Rubble Finds an old brass Jack-in-the-box with a Genie inside who grants him 3 wishes.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un funambolo
episodes.overview: Francois tries to walk a tightrope from Adventure Bay's Bridge to the Lookout.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una gara di snowboard
episodes.overview: Jake and Everest are excited today's the day of the big Snowboard Competition, until they look outside and see the course is completely buried under blanket of snow.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano una gallina di mare
episodes.overview: The Cap'n is about to test it out in an underwater adventure when Chickaletta, Cali and a seagull beat him to it. All the animal activity on the control panel drives the diving bell to the bottom of the bay.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano la partita
episodes.overview: The pups discover that their opponents in a soccer match are cheating.

episodes.title: I cuccioli salvano un collare fortunato
episodes.overview: Marshall wins a supposedly lucky collar, leading him to take unnecessary risks while helping Cap'n Turbot save an owl.

episodes.title: Cuccioli volanti
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot and Francois go on a monkey communication expedition, but are put in danger when the volcano on the island erupts. The PAW Patrol uses their new Air Patroller to rescue the two, along with a family of monkeys.

episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot tells the tale of how he learned to speak fluent "alien" while shipwrecked with an Alien Grandpa!

episodes.overview: A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

episodes.overview: Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the 'Hum-Kickers', and starts wrecking the town!

episodes.overview: In the jungle, Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck
episodes.overview: When the freezer in Mr. Porter's new Ice Cream Truck breaks, it's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the freezer before everything melts!

episodes.title: Pups Save a Woodland Walrus
episodes.overview: After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse! It's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him.

episodes.title: Pups Save a DJ in a Jam
episodes.overview: Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party on Jake's Mountain.

episodes.title: Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit
episodes.overview: After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a bouncy safety suit for him to wear. But when Danny bounces away, the PAW Patrol have to find him.

episodes.title: Pups Put a Mouse on the Move
episodes.overview: Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the cheese competition, and with Chase's nose plagued by allergies, he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue!

episodes.title: Pups Save a Solar System
episodes.overview: Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star. But when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Suitcase
episodes.overview: Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom. But when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

episodes.title: Fire Rescue: Pups and the Missing Water Mystery
episodes.overview: When Mr. Park's rooftop garden accidentally catches fire, the Fire Rescue Pups make a terrible discovery: there's no water in Adventure Bay! Marshall and Skye go in search of a solution to the missing water mystery before the flames start to spread.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
episodes.overview: A trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin. Now it's up to Everest and the pups to rescue Jake and find a way to get his home back.

Pups Stop the Garboni

episodes.title: Pups Save the Porcupine
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol have to catch a trouble making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

episodes.title: Pups and the Ace of the Skies
episodes.overview: Ace's plane gets stuck in the mountains while giving pilot lessons to Skye and it's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue the stranded pilots.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Babysitter
episodes.overview: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the PAW Patrol when animal hijinks ensue.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Farm Festival

episodes.overview: Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary. Her and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus.
